title: Tuvia
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Pesachim 113b tells his story: Tuvia sinned, and Zigur came alone to testify against him before Rav Papa, who flogged Zigur. Zigur said to him, “Tuvia sinned, and Zigud is flogged?” He replied, “Yes,” etc.

notes.text: The consulted paragraph identifies Rav Papa as the judge and respondent. Hyman alternates Zigur and Zigud; those name forms remain as supplied rather than silently corrected.
The consulted Pesachim passage uses Zigud throughout. Hyman’s text supplies both Zigur and Zigud.
